definitions.explanation: A processed seafood product made from white fish paste that is shaped and steamed. A staple ingredient in Japanese cuisine.

examples.japanese: かまぼこ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{薄|うす}く→薄い：00764_usui⟧⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧。
⟦ラーメン→ラーメン：05181_raamen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧かまぼこ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{乗|の}っている→乗る：00511_noru⟧。
examples.english: There's kamaboko on top of the ramen.

examples.japanese: ⟦おせち{料理|りょうり}→おせち料理：26981_osechiryouri⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{紅白|こうはく}→紅白：13805_kouhaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧かまぼこ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{欠|か}かせない→欠かす：10138_kakasu⟧。
examples.english: Red and white kamaboko are essential in New Year's dishes.

notes:
Also written as {蒲鉾|かまぼこ}. Made from surimi ({擂|す}り{身|み}), a paste of minced white fish.

TYPES:
- ⟦{板|いた}→板：01792_ita⟧かまぼこ: standard half-moon shaped kamaboko on a wooden board
- {笹|ささ}かまぼこ: leaf-shaped kamaboko (specialty of ⟦{仙台|せんだい}→仙台：30730_sendai⟧)
- ⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧: spiral-patterned kamaboko used in ramen
- ⟦{紅白|こうはく}→紅白：13805_kouhaku⟧かまぼこ: red and white kamaboko for celebrations

CULTURE: ⟦{紅白|こうはく}→紅白：13805_kouhaku⟧かまぼこ (red and white kamaboko) is a traditional part of ⟦おせち{料理|りょうり}→おせち料理：26981_osechiryouri⟧ (New Year's dishes). The half-moon shape is said to resemble the first sunrise of the year.
